desc:
Welcome to LOADED, the fast first person shooter where every duel ends in a slow motion final killcam! 💥

🔫 Fight 1v1 up to 4v4 duels, first team to 5 rounds wins
🃏 WILD DUELS: every round the deal changes the rules. Low gravity, one shot kills, giant mode and more
🎯 CLASSIC DUELS: no tricks, just pure aim
🔄 RESHUFFLE: free for all where everyone's gun rerolls every 30 seconds
🎬 Land the winning shot and watch the bullet fly to their head in slow motion
✨ Unlock skins, mastery camos, kill effects, tracers and finishers
📦 Open cases with keys and show off your loadout
👥 Party up with friends and queue together

🎮 Play on PC, mobile, tablet and console
⭐ Like and favorite the game so you don't miss updates!

⚠️ Cheaters and exploiters will be banned.
